html:
The house was
never the point.
It was always
the people around
the kitchen island.
captions: Every home I’ve ever loved had a crowded kitchen island. What’s the best memory made around yours?
The countertops matter less than who’s leaning on them. Who’s always at your island?

html:
One day
the cleats won’t fit.
Soak up every
muddy, noisy,
beautiful minute.
captions: Saturday sidelines, cold coffee and the best seat in the house. Soak it up, friends.
To every parent in a folding chair this weekend: these are the good days.

html:
You don’t need
a perfect plan.
You need a first step
and someone
in your corner.
captions: Thinking about your next move but not sure where to start? Start with a coffee and a conversation. I’m in your corner.
Nobody has it all mapped out. Take one small step this week. What’s yours?
